notes: FDA oversight flags describe reported registry fields, not product approval or a determination of reporting obligations.
FDAAA 801 violation is a reported registry boolean. False or absent does not establish compliance.
The registry does not distinguish a certification from an extension request in the combined dates.
Submitted, submitted with QC criteria, posted and posted with QC comments are retained as separate events.
Study documents are listed metadata only; their content and current availability are not validated.
Only valid full-day dates with compatible actual/undesignated date types produce elapsed-day calculations. Partial and estimated dates retain their precision without invented dates.
